message: type parameter `T` of termimad::errors::Result is () at all 24 instantiations the repo spells - name the type
why: `pub(crate) type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, Error>` is the standard Rust crate-error alias (the shape of std's own io::Result); its parameter is passed straight through to std::result::Result, so the alias adds no abstraction of its own to collapse, and naming the type would leave every Result-returning pub method spelling the error type by hand for no reader gain
